text:
Maria: quick decision needed for the upcoming 2-week mini-iteration. Do we prioritize the onboarding failure spike (500 errors/day for new users), or push the small contextual reranker enhancement customers asked for? Need plan by EOD.

Lee: onboarding errors feel highest impact. Do we have root-cause signal?

Maria: Support + telemetry: errors originate from token refresh failures in the auth service when payloads > 8kb, looks like an edge case but affects new orgs onboarding with large meta.

Dinesh: Enhancement note: reranker A/B showed +6% CTR in trials but requires schema change and a short model swap. Estimate: 5 days eng + 1 day QA + config. Low risk if behind flag.

Claire: If we only have 1 primary eng slot, my recommendation: 1) Mandatory: auth token refresh fix + monitoring/alerting. 2) Stretch: investigate memory leak on long polling (reported by one partner). 3) Defer reranker enhancement unless we can dock a second engineer part-time.

Maria: Proposed acceptance criteria for auth fix: reproducer in staging, PR with test, canary at 10% traffic for 24h with <1% error delta, rollback path, and updated runbook.

Lee: I can own the auth fix. Plan: reproduce today, PR tomorrow, deploy to canary day after. Will add a synthetic that simulates large payload onboarding flows.

Dinesh: I'll scope the reranker as two cards: 1) infra/schema + flag (2d) 2) model swap + eval (5d). We can start card 1 in parallel with low risk.

Claire: For the memory leak, put a quick tracer in the runtime and limit slot to 50% QA traffic. If we hit high memory, immediate rollback.

Maria: Ops requirement: add a PagerDuty key and a short runbook paragraph: how to identify the token refresh error, quick mitigation (temp reduce payload size / force-refresh), and who to page.

release-bot: reminder: update changelog and tag the hotfix if it goes to prod. Also include CVE-check if auth lib upgraded.

Maria: Final call: auth token refresh fix = top priority (must ship in this mini-iteration), memory leak triage = stretch, reranker infra spike = background if capacity. I'll update the sprint board and ping AE owners with expected window.

Lee: :thumbsup: starting reproduction now.

Dinesh: creating cards RE-RANK-07 (infra spike) and RE-RANK-08 (model swap). Linking to board.

Claire: adding QA acceptance criteria to the auth card and will prepare canary checklist: 
``
- run synthetic onboarding payloads
- verify token refresh success rate >99%
- monitor p95 latency for auth calls
- smoke tests for embeddings path
```

Maria: Great. Closing this thread, will post board link later and send a short note to sales/support with commitment ETA.
